## Overview

A named agent of the Crimson Covenant who requested the transfer of Subject 242 (Zan) from the Primary Facility to Gamma-7. His name appears in the Subject Transfer Ledger found in Gamma-7's Records Office (Room 5).

## Key Facts

- Named in the transfer order for Subject 242
- The transfer was flagged as "Covenant already requested — (UNFULFILLED — Subject escaped)"
- This means Agent Korvus requested Zan's transfer BEFORE Zan escaped
- His name is a trackable lead for the party

## Notes

Agent Korvus is likely based at the Primary Facility or another Covenant stronghold. His rank, position, and current location are unknown — the party would need to investigate further to find him.
